purpose: Stylized ocean-survival playable avatar. Distinct original art direction; do not copy proprietary Raft geometry or textures.

source_of_truth.baseline: A14 Quaternius CC0 skinned 65-joint sailor asset, before compact resculpt
source_of_truth.geometric_edits: Only Blender-modified rest mesh, bones, garments, props and exported GLB count as actual progress
source_of_truth.image_policy: Reference/concept images are inspiration only; never treat ImageGen artwork as a built 3D model or rendering evidence
source_of_truth.camera_policy: Locked 2x2 angles FRONT, 3/4, BACK, TOP from actual GLB under identical baseline/candidate framing
source_of_truth.rights: Quaternius CC0 base and independently authored RAFTBOUND costume; no proprietary Raft asset extraction

art_direction.silhouette: Compact, friendly survival character: shorter legs, slimmer arms and shoulders, readable slightly enlarged head
art_direction.face: Eyes visible beneath cap; expressive and not covered by a thick horizontal visor
art_direction.clothing: Simple layered cloth, clean neckline and hems; no bare hard-edged geometry masquerading as fabric
art_direction.materials: Ocean-worn teal, canvas brown, warm skin, dark weathered leather; no overly glossy superhero look
art_direction.accessories: Small cap, belt pouch, backpack, survival tool; attachments must deform/track appropriately
art_direction.animation: Idle arms naturally lowered, walk weight-shift, cast synced to game/cast-motion.js; verify 65-bone rig
art_direction.camera: Third-person gameplay camera has final approval; studio render alone is insufficient

hard_gates: Source mesh and rest rig exported together
All measurements satisfy locked silhouette blueprint
Four consistent real GLB camera renders
Before/after progression matrix from identical framing
Actual game-derived idle/walk/cast clips tested in Three.js
Artist approval >=4/5 each for silhouette, face, hands, clothing, gameplay readability, deformation
Production integration into actual shipping renderer after upgrading 17-bone cap

contributors.blueprint_and_silhouette: Artist or designer locks stylized proportions, silhouette and palette
contributors.geometry_and_rig: Blender owner adjusts CC0 topology + rig + clothing boundaries together
contributors.material_and_uv: Material owner handles glTF PBR and UV; must validate real exported baseColorFactor and COLOR_0
contributors.animation_and_runtime: Game developer verifies motion with actual cast JS and supported renderer bone count
contributors.master_review: Independent QA aggregates exact hashes, boards and measured artifacts; no silent changes to blueprint
